opening.argument: The video presents a Bitcoin investment and membership scheme with a concrete path from registration to payment verification. It instructs participants that “the first thing they want to do is make the payment of their investment,” then directs them to “enter the transaction ID here, upload a proof of payment.” Those funds are placed into a trading pool, where viewers are told they can earn “daily passive income.” The scheme also displays left and right teams and identifies “direct commissions and binary commissions” as earnings, while presenting “the trade results paid to the member.” The available evidence does not establish whether the trades or returns were genuine, but it does show a specific promotional solicitation requiring payment and proof of payment in exchange for claimed investment returns and commissions.
